title: Prism V4.2 Providers Configuration Schema
description:
Validates ~/.claude/skills/prism/config/providers.json and ~/.prism/providers.json.

Deep merge and null semantics (HC-07):
- Field NOT present in user override -> inherit from base
- Field present with value null -> explicit clear (result becomes null)
- Field present with concrete value -> override

Arrays are replaced as a whole (never merged element-wise) to avoid semantic ambiguity.

API keys MUST NOT appear in this file. Keys are always looked up via key_env indirection (HC-02).

config_version.description: Schema version. Must be exactly '1.0' for V4.2 (HC-01). Bumping this signals a breaking format change; panel.ps1 will refuse to load unknown versions.

providers.description: Map of provider alias -> provider config. Alias is user-chosen (e.g. 'tokenopen', 'deepseek', 'moonshot').

api_style.description: API style. V4.2 only supports 'openai-compatible' (Q1 decision). Future versions may add 'anthropic' / 'gemini' native styles.

base_url.description: Base URL. HTTPS is required for remote providers; local HTTP endpoints should use localhost and may be accepted by the runtime.

chat_path.description: Chat completions path appended to base_url (e.g. /v1/chat/completions).

auth_type.description: Authentication scheme. V4.2 supports 'bearer' (Authorization: Bearer $KEY). Future: 'x-api-key' / 'header-custom'.

key_env.description: Environment variable name that holds the API key (e.g. PRISM_TOKENOPEN_KEY). Key value itself is NEVER stored in this file (HC-02). Lookup order: process env -> ~/.prism/keys.env -> skill/scripts/keys.env (HC-09).

base_env.description: Optional env var name that can override base_url at runtime (HC-10). Explicit null clears any inherited value.

extra_headers.description: Extra HTTP headers to include with every request (e.g. {"X-Custom": "foo"}). Explicit null clears inherited headers.

request_defaults.description: Default request params for this provider. Model-level 'overrides' win over these; hard-coded fallbacks (0.7 / 8000) win if both missing.

max_attempts.description: Total attempt count (initial + retries). Defaults to 3.

retry_on_status.description: HTTP status codes that trigger a retry. Array is REPLACED wholesale in deep merge (not element-merged).

retry_on_body_match.description: Regex patterns matched against response body; a match triggers retry (e.g. 'fake_sse_empty_response'). Array is REPLACED wholesale.

backoff_seconds.description: Backoff delays between retries. Array length should equal (max_attempts - 1). Array is REPLACED wholesale.
